metadata.title: Nominal 2x sawn-lumber section geometry
metadata.source: American Wood Council FAQ: How do I convert to metric lumber sizes?
metadata.property_basis: Rectangular section with actual depth vertical; Ix and Sx are calculated from actual dimensions.
metadata.material_properties_note: Species, grade, E, and allowable bending stress are not included. Supply verified values for the selected species and grade; do not treat geometry alone as a strength rating.
metadata.dimension_note: The AWC FAQ lists soft metric conversions for these nominal sizes and explicitly illustrates the 2x4 actual size. The inch actual dimensions here are the corresponding customary sizes.
